name: Rimehollow Delve
description: An old dwarven delve sunk into the ice, its entrance a black mouth in a glacier wall.

discovery.message: A square-cut doorway in the glacier wall, half buried in snow: an old delve.

entrance.text: Cut stone steps lead down into the ice. Your breath hangs in front of you, and the walls are glazed with frost.

requirements.description: You need a light to go underground.

entrance.failure_text: Past the entrance it's black as pitch. You'd need a lit torch or lantern, or eyes that see in the dark, to go any further.

hazard.text: The cold down here gets into your bones. Every step takes more out of you.

face.text: The first gallery's face is laced with iron, and deeper, darker veins of deepiron catch your light.

way-down.text: Beyond the face the delve drops away down a shaft choked with fallen ice. Nobody's getting deeper until it's cleared.

leave.text: You climb back up into the daylight.
